column2: Then he's there...!
We storm in together!
We go after Rei Uryu and Dr. Kuruma...
...and find out where Maria is!
That's the spirit, everyone!!
Tomisaburo, we've got a lead.
Told ya my gut wasn't wrong when it said "follow those guys," right? After all, I'm Precog Clan too, y'know!
Then tell me where Maria is!
W-well, that's a bit... Heh heh...!
Hmph! Let's go, Tomisaburo!
Wait up for meee!
Rei Uryu's condo must be in Science City's off-limits area. Finding it should be the only way to learn where Maria is... Do your best!
How is {s} doing?
Ah, yes. Well, um, she seems much better. No need to worry.
...Really? You're not hiding something?
What!? No, well... Hey! Does anyone know what happened to those papers!? Sorry, {p}-kun! I'm busy right now!
Who'd have thought Dr. Kuruma and Rei Uryu, Science City's sponsor, were in cahoots... I never noticed, I tell you...
We gave Mazinger Z a proper tune-up. Aphrodite A and Boss Borot too, of course!
Mazinger Z is the only one that can fly with the Jet Scrander.
Sorry, {p}-kun! I'm busy right now!
For now, let's head back to Hell Villa...
I have to go to Science City now! You'll all come with me, right?
What's wrong, everyone?
Why won't anyone say anything?
...Well, you see, {p}...
Congrats on getting better!
We all kept quiet the whole time because we wanted to surprise you!
So that's what it was!
{p}... and everyone...! Sorry I made you worry! But I'm fine now!
All riiight! Off to Science City!
...! An earthquake...!
...! Could it be...!?
Kyaaa!
The black moon!
Wh-what is going on...!
It's a big one! The shaking's worse than usual!
Are the worlds trying to merge again...!?
{p}... Can't we get away...?
Kyaaa!
Whoaaa!
{!R}This is an emergency! This is an emergency!
Uhh... nnn...?
...Does an earthquake that bad hit whenever the black moon shows up?
This time was extra nasty!
Hey, looks like something else happened!

{!R}Strange events have occurred all over the world!\n\n{!R}A gigantic sphere of light has appeared near the North Pole! {!R}The entire surrounding area appears to have vanished! Please look at this satellite photo.
What tremendous energy!
{!R}News is also coming in from within Japan. {!R}A pond called Hasunuma suddenly vanished, and a housing area appeared in its place!
{!R}Even stranger, the people living in the housing area {!R}reportedly say they've never heard of any Hasunuma!
Honey, maybe that housing area is...?
Seiji Hayami-kun's house might be there... I'll go tell Seiji-kun!
Looks like we'd better get ready and head for Science City too.
I'm going for sure, no matter what anyone says!
Are you sure you're okay, {s}?
No need to worry!
I'm coming too, {p}.\n\nIf Rei Uryu's in Science City, there's no way I'm not going!
I'm going as well. I have a bad feeling about this...
All right! You two come with me!
We're thinking of checking out where Hasunuma used to be. Maybe this time my house will actually be there...
Just the two of us would be risky, so I'm thinking of bringing some friends along.
So who are you taking?
I've been with {p} and Honey since the Hill of Beginnings. I'd be glad to help either of you.
Things are gettin' serious. My blood's pumpin'!
As long as I'm with Mondo, I'll go anywhere.
The world is starting to crumble... That's how it feels...!
I'm always on {p} and Honey's side!
One thing after another, the human world sure has it rough, I do declare.
And the North Pole was the comfiest place in the whole human world!
Whoever I go with, it's gonna be a blast!
Boss, you take things way too easy... But will we be okay?
{p}, Honey, don't let your guard down!
This has gotten tricky. Better think it through.
Wherever it may be, my duty is to protect Doji!
Is danger drawing near the Kigoku World as well?
I'm scared... But I won't give in!
I'll show you what Mazinger Z's really got!
This time Aphrodite A's going to shine!
Don't you underestimate Boss Borot, Honey-chan!
I'd rather follow Honey-chan than the Boss!
When it counts, we deliver! Watch us, Honey-chan!
As a boxer, I'm way beyond high-school level. Perfect bodyguard material!
Yeah, got it! Let's both do our best!
{p}, you all be careful too!
Whoaaa!
Kyaaa!
What's going on!?
I don't know! Let's get to the roadside!
Looks like we got ambushed...!
Demon Beast Hunters coming from over there!
And the Immortal Corps from this side!
Why are the Demon Beast Hunters and the Immortal Corps teaming up?
Beats me! Let's think about it if we live!
Heh heh! It's on now!\n\nLet's slip in while they're distracted and get inside Science City!
